item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 23/Aug/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Ma-on now over the vicinity of Luzon will enter the northeastern part of the South China Sea tonight, edging closer to the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary and intensifying gradually on Wednesday and Thursday. There will be heavy squally showers and thunderstorms over the region. The weather will be windy and seas will be high with swells, and will lead to storm surge. The landfall intensity of Ma-on still remain uncertain. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually, the weather will improve over the coastal areas of Guangdong in the latter part of this week.

Date/Month: 24/08 (Wednesday)
Wind: North to northwest force 4, force 5 to 6 at night.
Weather: Very hot with sunny periods and haze. A few squally showers and thunderstorms later. There will be swells.
Temp range: 28 - 34 C
R.H. range: 60 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium

Date/Month: 25/08 (Thursday)
Wind: Northeast force 5 to 6 at first. Becoming southeast force 7 to 8 in the morning, up to force 11 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Cloudy to overcast with heavy squally showers and thunderstorms. Seas will be very rough to high with swells.
